description: What accounts are doing: positions taken in posts on X and Telegram.. level=calls: each post that opened, added to, trimmed, reaffirmed, reversed, closed or stopped out of a position. level=episodes: each position from open to close, with entry and exit prices and the author's track record. level=positioning: open longs and shorts on one asset right now. level=episodes with status=open and from set to now reads what every matching account holds right now. Not returned: post text or a recommendation.

assetClass.description: level=episodes. The market of the position's asset.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous reply. Change any argument but limit and it fails; start again without it.

entityId.description: level=positioning, required. One token or equity id from the entities tool.

entityIds.description: Up to 30 token or equity ids from the entities tool. Matches any of them.

from.description: level=calls or episodes. Start of the range, unix seconds, not milliseconds. Required unless you fetch by ids. Episodes match a position open at any point in the range.

handle.description: An X account, with or without @. Telegram channels cannot be filtered on.

ids.description: level=calls or episodes. Fetch up to 30 call or episode ids you already hold. No from needed.

limit.description: Items per page, up to 30. Keep it small and page with cursor rather than asking for everything at once.

to.description: End of the range, unix seconds. Defaults to now.

name: calls
title: Calls
